steps.say: This row always counts everything below the level you are on, each person once. A group's figures already include every school, class and learner underneath it.
**Class practice** is the hours classes have practised together beneath here, and **Classes practising this week** is how many of them have run a session in the last seven days.

**Teachers** and **Learners** count the people below this level, each once however many classes they are in. Stand on a class and the same row switches to that class's own sessions this week, its practice hours, its students and its teachers.
steps.terminal: One row, the same grammar at every level. This tour changed nothing; only your own taps do.
